goal: Open the fixed asset depreciation journal route read-only and document whether Calculate Depreciation / Preview Posting / Post actions are visible without changing data.

unlockedBy.decision: Only read-only route discovery is unlocked; no journal line or preview execution.

acceptanceCriteria: Business Central stays in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO.
The fixed asset journal or depreciation route context is opened read-only.
Visible action candidates are classified: Calculate Depreciation, Preview Posting, Post/Post and Print.
No journal line is inserted or edited.
No Calculate Depreciation, Preview Posting or Post action is clicked.
Result decides whether a later Preview Posting-only execution case can be planned.
stopConditions: Business Central shows a different instance or company.
The target page requires New/Edit before any route context is visible.
Only a posting-capable route is visible and cannot be classified read-only.
nextSafeAction: Run exactly one read-only route-discovery test; do not create/edit journal lines, calculate depreciation, preview or post.
